note.note:
I’m ready to generate the SOAP note, but I’m missing the actual transcript and the DDx JSON. Please provide:

- The full clinician–patient transcript (as text)
- The Differential Diagnosis (DDx) list in JSON format (as provided by your diagnostic agent)

Once received, I will produce:

Subjective:
- Current issues, reason for visit, and history of presenting illness (onset, duration, progression)
- Past medical history, prior surgeries (if applicable)
- Medications (with dose/route/frequency noted if provided; otherwise “dose/route/frequency not documented”)
- Social history (if applicable)
- Allergies

Objective:
- Physical examination findings (including specific sites, sides, and body systems examined)
- Vitals and relevant measurements (only if present in transcript)
- Investigations and results (if provided)

Assessment & Plan:

1. [Issue/Diagnosis name]
   - Likely diagnosis
   - Differential diagnoses (from DDx, included only if consistent with transcript; mark “conflict noted” if conflicts with transcript)
   - Investigations planned
   - Treatments planned
   - Referrals (if applicable)

2. [Second issue, if present]
   - etc.

3. [Additional issues, if present]

Quality checks (to be included at bottom or as document_quality):
- Missing but clinically expected elements (e.g., allergies, meds reconciliation)
- Internal conflicts between transcript and DDx (mark “conflict noted”)
- Brief note on transcript quality if noisy/inaudible

Please paste the transcript and the DDx exactly as provided.
